C1.worst_defect: The hero explains the product to developers, not to a shop owner: the line reads "(Vendure is an open-source headless commerce framework)". Nothing above the fold tells the owner that a developer must first install a plugin and run migrations before staff can sell. That fact only becomes clear in the quick start.

C2.worst_defect: The payment screenshot on the docs page shows a test-data product, "Tally Fixture Mug". It looks like a test rig rather than a shop.

C3.worst_defect: Refunds are missing from the real-store till, which is stated honestly as "On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund... If you hand back cash, record it on the till with Pay out". The owner learns this only after a developer has finished steps 1-7 of the quick start (npm, TallyPosPlugin, tsx migrations, bearer tokenMethod, CORS, tax strategy). No single page answers "can my staff sell tomorrow" with a yes or no and a checklist for the owner.

C4.worst_defect: The troubleshooting entry "N till updates need attention" is one long paragraph aimed at a developer: turn on DEBUG, find a "Register command result ... status=rejected errorCode=..." line in Settings > Sync log, then "Any other code: the till has no retry or skip, and fixing the store does not make it send the update again." Counter staff get no plain instruction on what to do now.

C5.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet screenshot is a different capture on each device. Desktop shows "open since 06:01". Phone shows "open since 03:31", "Last synced 3:31 AM" and "Sync now", with a grey vertical strip down the image's left edge.

C6.worst_defect: On phone the hero till screenshot shrinks so far that the cart column header is cut to "Q..." and the till UI cannot be read. Troubleshooting entries are 15+ line walls of text on a 390px screen.

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse mobile LCP is 2.4 s, with an unused-JavaScript finding on / and /docs/quick-start. Everything else is complete: 404 status, sitemap, robots, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, JSON-LD, OG image, and a search API.

overall_worst.defect: When sales or register updates get stuck, the troubleshooting entry "N till updates need attention" gives the owner and counter staff no plain action. It sends them to dig a DEBUG "status=rejected errorCode=..." line out of Settings > Sync log, then says "the till has no retry or skip, and fixing the store does not make it send the update again". On a phone between customers this reads as "your sales may be lost and you can't do anything".
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 / troubleshooting.phone.01, "N till updates need attention"
overall_worst.fix: Open the entry with two lines for the cashier: "Keep selling. Don't reload or sign out. Close the day as normal and tell whoever runs your store." Then add one sentence on whether the stuck sales are safe. Move the sync-log, errorCode and tallyResolveNeedsAdmin detail into a sub-section headed "For whoever runs your Vendure server".
